text:
maria: Heads-up — saw premium tenants getting swapped to cheaper variants mid-session when primary saturates. We lose sticky KV cache and see latency spikes.
oliver: yup, spotted in traces. Primary GPU pool hit hard cap and our current fallback is stateless round-robin to any compatible variant.
rachel: proposal: implement 'sticky variant swap' — if we must move an in-flight session, try to preserve tenant->variant affinity for the rest of that session or rebind back to an equivalent in same tier/region.
sanjay: careful — for Dedicated/reserved customers we must not evict their pinned capacity. Routing should respect customer_tier: DEDICATED > PREMIUM_HOSTED > FREE.
maria: suggestion: routing hierarchy + policy modes. By default use tier-aware fallback: try same-tier & same-region variants, then degrade to cross-region only with opt-in. Also mark the event in traces.
oliver: agree. Technical note: warmed KV/prefix caches on primary won't transfer; migrating loses amortized token savings. Could consider cross-variant prefix caching but that's heavy.
rachel: console UX: display an "auto-variant swap" event in the request trace row, show which variant served, and surface a per-tenant toggle in Rollouts: 'allow_capacity_fallback'.
sanjay: API debate: do we expose a request header like X-Redwood-Routing: preferSticky=true, allowedFallbacks=[quantized,v2-small] or keep server-side opt-in only?
adele (deploy-bot): canary deploy queued: routing/fallback/v2 -> canary (5%) in 20m.
maria: lean server-side defaults + account-level opt-out. Header approach OK for advanced customers but shouldn't be required.
oliver: telemetry we need: fallback_rate, fallback_latency_delta, fallback_rate_by_tier, sticky_rebind_failures, and sample traces when fallback_rate > 1% for a tenant.
rachel: new rollout model: fallback_policy with modes {off, best-effort, tier-aware, hard-reject}. 'tier-aware' = prefer same-tier variants, 'best-effort' = any compatible fallback. Add rollout flag in Console.
sanjay: streaming requests are tricky — cannot transparently migrate streams. For streaming, return 503 with Retry-After and fallback suggestion unless the connector supports migration.
oliver: example config snippet we discussed:
```json
{
  "fallback_policy": "tier-aware",
  "preserve_sticky_for_session": true,
  "max_fallback_attempts": 2,
  "allowed_cross_region": false
}
```
rachel: tests: we'll simulate pool saturation in k8s e2e harness, assert fallback_rate < 5% for PREMIUM, ensure no cross-tier swaps unless allowed. Also assert trace logs contain fallback events with variant ids.
maria: ops playbook: when fallback spike detected show tenant list, root cause (pool saturation / eviction / misconfig), suggested remediations (increase reserved capacity / pin variant / enable controlled spillover).
adele (deploy-bot): :thumbsup: I'll add dashboard cards: fallback_rate_by_tier, avg_latency_penalty, live-swaps_stream.
oliver: cost note — fallback to a quantized variant reduces compute cost but may increase latency and change output quality. Add cost_estimate fields to trace for post-hoc billing analysis.
sanjay: ownership: oliver/runtime handles routing changes + migration hooks, rachel/platform owns rollout flags & tests, maria/console adds trace UI and tenant toggles, I'll own policy docs and compliance notes. Ship canary next week?
maria: I'll open a PR with the policy proto + routing changes and link this thread. Thanks everyone — tagging follow-ups in the PR.
